title: Geopolitical Daily
email_subject: Three nuclear powers test a first summit
preheader: Trump says Washington and Beijing should help end the Ukraine war.
intro_text: Good morning. It's Thursday, November 19, 2026 — the 3 stories that matter most today, plus 1 update on stories you're following and 5 quick items from around the world.

stories.story_title: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit in Shenzhen
stories.why_important: The leaders of the world's three biggest nuclear powers met for the first time. Trump told Xi that Washington and Beijing should help end the Ukraine war before talks with Putin. The Kremlin said Ukraine was the main topic of the Putin-Trump meeting.
stories.what_overlooked: Beijing said the meeting was about 'world peace.' No joint statement or nuclear deal has been announced, and analysts expect more show than real results.
stories.prediction: A joint statement or follow-up nuclear talks within 72 hours would show whether the summit produced more than photos.

stories.story_title: UN court to rule on Myanmar genocide case against Rohingya
stories.why_important: The International Court of Justice will rule on whether Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya Muslims in 2017. The verdict could set a legal standard for genocide cases. It could also affect South Africa's case against Israel over Gaza.
stories.what_overlooked: Le Monde reports growing US attempts to pressure the court's judges, but Washington has not confirmed this. The ruling may also shape the Gaza case.
stories.prediction: The court's published verdict and whether Myanmar accepts or rejects it will show how much weight the ruling carries.

stories.story_title: US and Venezuela sign military partnership after Maduro's ouster
stories.why_important: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth signed a defense deal in Caracas. The deal restores defense ties after US forces captured Nicolas Maduro in January. It turns Venezuela from a regional rival into a US partner on defense. It also reshapes armed forces and government ties in Latin America.
stories.what_overlooked: The agreement's terms are not public, so it is unclear how Venezuela's interim government or neighbors like Colombia and Brazil will respond.
stories.prediction: If the deal terms become public, or Colombia or Brazil reacts within 72 hours, we will see how far the partnership goes.

quick_hits.text: Russia halted trains on the Kerch Bridge after a third drone attack in a week, Ukraine's General Staff indirectly acknowledged the strike.
Trump envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are expected in Berlin to meet Ukrainian and European officials on ending Russia's war.
The US charged Russian national Igor D'iu with spying on Palantir employees because the company supplies weapons to Ukraine.
A Miami court convicted Florida pastor Christian Emmanuel Sanon over the 2021 assassination of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there is 'zero' information that the recent wave of US tech outages was linked to a malign actor.
